Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent or recklessness); inadvertently leaving the stove on is mere negligence and does not supply malice.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle has two phases, systole and diastole; contraction and relaxation name those phases, and there is no separate rest phase.

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds form an open crystal lattice, so higher pressure favors the denser liquid and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
